agency: State of New York Mortgage Agency (SONYMA), part of NYS Homes and Community Renewal

programs.name: SONYMA Down Payment Assistance Loan (DPAL)

amount.text: the greater of $3,000 or 3% of the purchase price, up to $15,000; $1,000 minimum

programs.repayment: 0% interest, no monthly payments, forgiven after 10 years; the amount subject to repayment drops by 1/120 each month of occupancy
programs.firstTimeNote: used with SONYMA first-mortgage programs (Achieving the Dream, Low Interest Rate, Homes for Veterans…); veterans and targeted areas exempt
programs.rateNote: first mortgages with a DPAL carry a rate 0.40 point higher
programs.note: hcr.ny.gov blocked to scripts (Cloudflare); terms from the official pages' indexed text
